| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High — international NLP authorship |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium — multilingual NLP welcomes diverse languages |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | Medium — low-resource languages, multilingual fairness |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Computational linguistics — formal linguistics + NLP, syntax / semantics / pragmatics computational treatment, multilingual NLP, LLM linguistic analysis |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (very strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **substantial computational linguistics contribution** — ACL flagship venue. Pure ML without linguistic insight redirected.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure ML / engineering NLP redirected to ACL conferences or TACL.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure ML / engineering NLP without linguistic insight
- AI use without disclosure per MIT Press policy
- No reproducibility (code + data sharing)

### Soft Tax

Low for ACL-tradition computational linguistics authors.

### Best Suited For

- Formal computational linguistics
- Multilingual NLP research
- LLM linguistic analysis
- Semantic parsing / discourse processing
- Low-resource language NLP
- Linguistically-motivated NLP method advances

### Not Recommended For

- Pure ML benchmarking without linguistic insight
- Pure NLP applications (consider TACL, ACL conferences)
- Pure HCI dialogue systems (consider TOCHI)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | *(TACL — Transactions of ACL — community contribution welcome)* | ACL OA peer venue |
| 2 | *(ACL / EMNLP / NAACL proceedings — community contribution welcome)* | ACL conference venues |
| 3 | [Cognition](./cognition.md) | If cognitive-linguistic theoretical contribution |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a top general ML venue as "too linguistic," Computational Linguistics is the ACL flagship home for formal CL.
